author: GamingBolt
description:
As the Xbox turns 25 this year, Xbox Game Studios is pulling out all the stops to ensure that its players and fans have as many reasons to celebrate with it as they possibly can. From a new Gears of War title to a remake of Halo, there's a lot to celebrate for franchise veterans who have been waiting to sink their teeth into them. 

But with Fable and Forza Horizon 6 already slated for release this year, it looks like Xbox owners are going to have a busy year ahead as they dive into titles that have been a long time coming.
title: 2026 Is Xbox's Year To Lose - ALL Games Under Development At Xbox Game Studios

author: GamingBolt
description:
If we’re talking Resident Evil Requiem characters, we must start with Raccoon City itself. Yes, it may be wiped off the map, but its shockwave permeated everything after. 

The wreckage circling its colossal impact crater still burns, and for FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft – Requiem’s new-to-the-series protagonist – this is more than smouldering history, but trauma she’s inherited. 

Unlike Resident Evil’s legacy bearer Leon, the game’s second playable character, Grace tiptoes through the dark without the armour of experience forged by Leon, Claire, Jill, Chris, and the rest of the series’ surviving characters.
title: Resident Evil Requiem - All Confirmed Characters + The Biggest Rumored Returns

author: GamingBolt
description:
Code Violet is one of those games whose potential to be more than it is makes the entire thing feel all the more disappointing as a result. It squanders an interesting premise by presenting its story in such a convoluted fashion that it fails to capture the attention of its audiences. 

Its dinosaurs might have been a redeeming factor if their viciousness was backed up by predatory instincts that made them a challenge to take on. Its levels feel like they were designed to keep you running around in circles to pad out its thankfully shorter runtime. 

This one's not going to be among the year's best titles, not by a long shot. What an epic disaster!
title: Code Violet PS5 Review - Even MindsEye Was Better Than This MESS
